name: @retreever/create-rapper
_why: THE THIN RAPPER: a SvelteKit config, an app shell, and the children — nothing else. Every script and dependency here must be traceable to something this project actually runs.
_why_tailwind: Tailwind v4 is live: gc/theme.css and gc/base.css `@import 'tailwindcss'` — v4 syntax, so there is no `@tailwind` directive to grep for, and its absence has been misread as 'unused' once already. postcss.config.js loads @tailwindcss/postcss; ReTreever_who_what/lib/cn.ts uses tailwind-merge.
_why_prepublishOnly: prepublishOnly, not prepack: gitEr/packTest.sh runs `npm pack` itself, so prepack would recurse. It proves the tarball installs and builds every child in a sterile dir — several minutes, ~2 GB. Never `npm publish --ignore-scripts`: that publishes something no one has proven installs.

scripts._why_predev: rapper ships no static/: without this copy every /mobileAssets/worldBase/… request from the mounted child (basemap tiles, glyphs) 404s, and a child cannot fetch across into a parent. The copy is gitignored; ReTreever/static/mobileAssets is the source. Names no child — the mounted one is read from kit.files.routes; a hardcoded name once broke `npm run dev` for every other install, since a failing pre-script aborts the script it precedes and only `npm run dev` exercises predev (packTest.sh never does).

description: A SvelteKit rapper that runs any one of ReTreever and Get Cache's component repos on its own.
